Tamil Nadu Challenges High Court Order Banning Cow Slaughter

The Tamil Nadu government has moved the Supreme Court against a High Court order banning cow slaughter, citing concerns over the ban's impact on the state's economy and cultural practices. The move comes after the High Court directed the state to strictly enforce a ban on cow slaughter across Tamil Nadu.
